name: South Fork Snake (Swan Valley)
blurb: Swan Valley reaches of the South Fork Snake below Palisades Dam, with Spring Creek access at the highway bridge and Conant farther downstream.

sections.notes: Start at the public river ramp below Palisades Dam via Riverside Parkway, not a reservoir ramp. Both markers show approximate access areas. Spring Creek is at the Swan Valley Highway bridge; river levels depend on dam releases. Identify the usable ramp and takeout before launching.

distanceEvidence.sourceName: BLM — Regulations for Floating the South Fork of the Snake River, access table
distanceEvidence.streamId: South Fork Snake / agency river miles from Palisades Dam
distanceEvidence.note: Approximate planning distance from published agency river-mile markers; actual channels and launch connections vary. This does not calibrate live travel speed.

notices.title: Plan your access and overnight arrangements
notices.text: Launch at designated sites and check current facility fees, road conditions and closures. Overnight camping requires the self-issued permit and designated camps; follow the river’s waste and fire rules.
notices.sourceName: BLM — South Fork Snake boating regulations

notices.title: Help pinpoint these landings
notices.text: These markers show documented access areas. If you know the exact launch or takeout, use Report a correction to share its location and help improve the map.
notices.sourceName: BLM — South Fork Snake boating maps

sections.routeReview: Access areas are shown. The dotted river course still needs review around islands and changing channels.

putInAccess.operator: U.S. Forest Service — Caribou-Targhee National Forest
putInAccess.sourceName: USFS — Palisades Dam Boat Landing; BLM — South Fork Snake boating map 1
putInAccess.note: BLM map 1 locates the named boat access beside the paved loop below the dam; satellite imagery corroborates the ramp and road layout. The marker represents that approximate access area, not a surveyed landing. The Forest Service web/GIS coordinate points far east of the dam and is not used. Help refine the marker through the correction link if you know the landing.
putInAccess.directions: Follow the signed Palisades Dam boat access below the dam via Riverside Parkway. Confirm the usable ramp and takeout while setting your shuttle. This is the river launch, not Calamity on the reservoir or Palisades Creek.

takeOutAccess.operator: U.S. Forest Service — Caribou-Targhee National Forest
takeOutAccess.sourceName: BLM — South Fork Snake public access and boating regulations
takeOutAccess.note: USFS facility point lies near the river bank, away from the visible ramp. BLM map 4 independently identifies Spring Creek beside the highway bridge. Retain as an approximate area; do not confuse it with Conant two river miles downstream.
takeOutAccess.directions: Use the signed Spring Creek boat access at the Swan Valley Highway bridge. The marker is the Forest Service facility point; confirm the concrete ramp and exit before launching.

sections.notes: A short reach from the Spring Creek access at the highway bridge to Conant. BLM notes waves and turbulent water upstream of Conant. Identify the intended concrete or raft takeout before launching; do not assume a slow tubing trip.

takeOutAccess.note: BLM public GIS identifies the Conant facility at the parking/staging area. Imagery and BLM river-mile map agree on this location. Reject the visit-page coordinate near Spring Creek; do not snap this staging point to a guessed shoreline landing.
takeOutAccess.directions: Follow Conant Valley Loop to the signed Conant boat access. Concrete-boat and raft launch areas are separate. Confirm your chosen launch or takeout and use the designated parking.

timing.note: Published river-mile distances and access information are available. The legacy reference-flow speed has no documented trip calibration for these reviewed sections, so no live duration is shown until calibration is reviewed.
